package.name: crusader_fcu
package.description:
The autopilot gateway. telemetry_bridge is the single ROS-side consumer of the MAVProxy rebroadcast and the single sender back to it, so it is both the Localization source and the Movement actuator. Nothing else in the workspace may open a MAVLink connection TO THE AUTOPILOT.
Narrowed from "may open a MAVLink connection" on 2026-09-10, when crusader_link/rxl_link_node was added. That node speaks MAVLink to the RADIO: a different endpoint, the RobotX dialect, and a message set with no command in it, so it cannot arm, set a mode or move the boat. The invariant that matters is unchanged and is about the AUTOPILOT -- one path in, one path out, mode-gated. Any node that wants to reach the Pixhawk still goes through this one.
